ingredients: Tamarind, fish sauce, honey and salt, to taste
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic, ginger and lemongrass with the curry paste until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown, then the coconut milk, tomato purée, lime leaves and vegetables. Simmer until cooked.
Balance with tamarind, fish sauce, honey and salt.
